meta.title: Recreate Order with Quantity Requested = 2.5
gaps: Verify the exact backend enforcement of decimal vs whole units across different unit types during recreate order
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the exact backend enforcement of decimal vs whole units across different unit types during recreate order

steps.note: Start from the prepared closed RFQ summary page
Open the settings menu on the RFQ stage and select Recreate Order
Type 2.5 into the Quantity Requested cell on the create screen of the recreated order
Assert whether the decimal quantity 2.5 is kept or refused in the quantity field
